svg.text: NO CANDIDATE IS SUFFICIENTLY SUPPORTED TO SELECT. Covered pixels do not validate hidden shape.
O is not positive evidence. W is a weak clue, not an approved contour. D supports only the property stated.
Each cell lists hypothesis A / B / C. Identical labels expose underdetermination; no score or winner is computed.
Height and breadth of maximum depth
WHAT MULTIPLE S4 OBSERVATIONS REALLY CONSTRAIN
Purple surfaces appear in the opening and below cloth.
Scalloped white boundaries cross purple and change with pose.
Some lower purple outlines are smooth and taper toward the waist.
Purple paint marks weakly suggest curvature; they do not measure
Side exposure limits some local connections, not complete upper
Medial-versus-outer forward distribution and exact front width.
Maximum depth, its height and the span of the fullest region.
Hidden lower-return length, anterior-to-lateral wrap and whole
Physical garment contact, lift and clearance; all remain UNKNOWN.
No direct hidden-geometry support. No candidate-specific contradiction is established from covered pixels.
The absence of contradiction is not support. X is reserved for conflict with an actual observed body constraint.
S1 contributes neutral posture and landmark ordering only. Costume cups, bodice outline and depth are excluded.
Candidate C bridge depth is explicitly free. A/B anterior turning and B widest span are equally unobserved.
All chosen dimensions, section handles, synthetic tones and flow lines are proposal choices, never anime measurements.
DECISION: STOP FOR REVIEW. NO WINNER. NO MODELING TARGET FROZEN.
Complete per-candidate / per-frame / per-constraint reasons are in the CSV, JSON and written study.
No mesh edits. No garment mesh edits. No GLB builds. No Geometry Test 3.
